# Shawn Pana

> Shawn Pana (@shawn_pana) leads growth at Browser Use (YC W25), building tools that let AI agents use the web.

## About

Shawn Pana studied Mathematics-Computer Science and Music at UC San Diego. He is a
multi-time hackathon winner and now leads growth at Browser Use (YC W25), where he
works on tools that let AI agents use the web. He also makes music.

## Projects

- [smux](https://github.com/ShawnPana/smux): a tmux config with built-in terminal automation and agent-to-agent communication.
- [aurl](https://github.com/ShawnPana/aurl): a CLI tool that turns any API (OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL) into a command.
- [browser-use](https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use): the open-source library that lets AI agents control a browser.
